appearance_facts.fact: Blue solid line with circle markers represents 'Agriculture (%)'
Red dashed line with square markers represents 'Industry (%)'
Blue circle marker at 2014 on the blue line, labeled '16.35%'
Red square marker at 2014 on the red line, labeled '26.62%'

public_definitions: Review the public economic structure dashboard, compare the 2014 sector share percentage for Agriculture and Industry, then open the economic sector follow-up record for the sector with the larger 2014 percentage.
Use the economic sector share dashboard as the evidence source for deciding which 2014 sector percentage is larger.
